fields.Name: IT179 - List From Query
fields.Description: Live proof of making a list from SQL written in a conversation, deterministic (no model calls). LQ1: the SQL is saved as a Pending query in the user's own subcategory of User Lists. LQ2: saving again under the same name picks an unused name in the same category. LQ3: a list made from the saved query is linked to it, filled, and takes its fingerprint. LQ4: the list refreshes from the query while it is still Pending. LQ5: editing the query's SQL stops the refresh with SOURCE_CHANGED and applies nothing. The bundle creates and tears down its own queries and list, and the user's User Lists category when it created it.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Conversation SQL becomes a Pending User Lists query; the list made from it refreshes until the query is edited, then stops for review.
